avis.titre: Not a miracle for pores, but a total game-changer for my oily skinNot a miracle for pores, but a total game-changer for
avis.texte: I have been using this SKIN1004 Poremizing Fresh Ampoule for about 5 weeks now and I am genuinely impressed with how well it manages my T-zone oil throughout the day. The texture is slightly thicker than water but absorbs incredibly fast without any sticky residue leaving my skin feeling bouncy and refreshed almost instantly. Since it contains Himalayan pink salt I have noticed my face stays matte for much longer even under makeup and it has not caused any irritation on my sensitive skin thanks to the Centella. While it does not make my pores literally disappear it definitely makes them look much cleaner and less saggy by refining my overall skin texture. The only reason I am giving it 4 stars instead of 5 is that it is not quite hydrating enough for me to use on its own during colder months or on my dry patches so I always have to layer a moisturizer on top. Overall it is a solid addition to my skincare routine for a blurred matte finish and better sebum control

avis.titre: Nice product line & improves my skin
avis.texte: I have the centella ampoule cleansing foam & the centella ampoule serum. I've been using both and love the way it makes my skin feel. I wanted to try the poremizing ampoule because I have rosacea with bumps under my skin & cysts. Silicone seems to cause flare-ups so I'm careful with hyaluronic formulas that may add silicone. This ampoule made my skin feel instantly relieved of any irritation even after using an Aveeno cleanser pad. It dries down after 5 min & leaves no oily residue. The other ampoule serum left my skin with a film like moisturizer. The T-zone however felt normal with no residue, like the serum was reacting to my oily T-zone & didn't hold onto extra moisture. I had no reaction to this serum & my skin doesn't feel taught or dry, unlike when I use soap to remove my full coverage makeup. I don't want my skin to be glossy or greasy feeling as this may cause flare-ups but this ampoule has been making my skin feel better. After using it twice a day for a week, I noticed that it was drying out my skin. But that was because I slather my face with it & use the other ampoule on top to hydrate. I would say to start off using it lightly once a day.

. I really enjoy using this serum. It feels very light on the skin and absorbs quickly without leaving a sticky feeling. After a few days of use, my skin looked smoother, more hydrated, and refreshed. I also noticed that my pores appeared smaller and my skin tone looked more even. The packaging is beautiful and the product feels high quality. Great option for sensitive skin and daily skincare routine. I would definitely purchase again!

Almost all Skin1004 products are excellent; they’re suitable for all skin types and come in low concentrations to avoid irritating the skin. This serum is a great way to incorporate some peptides into your routine, as it doesn’t feel heavy—it literally absorbs like water—and it’s helped me with my sensitive, irritated skin. I don’t really see much of an effect when it comes to tightening pores, but when I use it with the clay mask from the same line, I feel like my nose stays blackhead-free a little longer.

avis.titre: Gentle Cleanser That Doesn’t Leave My Skin Tight
avis.texte: I’ve been using the SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Poremizing Foam for a bit now and it’s been a solid daily cleanser. It lathers nicely but doesn’t feel harsh or stripping. After rinsing, my skin feels clean but not dry or tight, which is usually my biggest issue with foaming cleansers. It’s lightweight and has a very mild scent that doesn’t linger. I like that it leaves my skin feeling refreshed without that squeaky, over-cleansed feeling. I’ve been using it in the morning and at night, and it works well without irritating my skin. If you’re expecting it to dramatically shrink pores overnight, that’s not really what it does, but it does keep my skin feeling balanced and smooth. Overall, a gentle, dependable cleanser that I’d repurchase.

During the first week, I broke out in pimples (I believe my skin was adjusting and purging impurities from the inside out); after that, I didn't get any more breakouts, and my skin started looking cleaner and more radiant. I thought the packaging was beautiful—large and minimalist. I loved it. 10/10
Good size and this poremizing products are the best, I’ve improved a lot my skin texture
I'M SO MAD.... That I broke my bottle and I like it so much I have to buy a new bottle 😆😆😆 it works great definitely get it. I have large pores and it makes my makeup look good.

avis.titre: Al parecer sí reduce los porosAl parecer sí reduce los poros
avis.texte: Llevo tres semanas de uso y creo que sí hay efectos. Uso este producto y después el "packing night" también de Centella Skin 1004 que mantengo en el refrigerador. Lo uso por la mañana y noche o después de bañarme. En clima tropical se me han agrandado los poros y creo que es una buena opción. No había empleado antes algo contra los poros abiertos, excepto algunas mascarillas de caolín. El producto es genuino. El empaque tiene su cartoncillo sedoso, las calcomanías con holograma y la parte superior con gota de agua, además de la fecha de hechura y de expiración. El líquido es suave e inocuo, puede sentirse algo pegajoso. Usé la misma cámara, claro que puede cambiar la luz.
Ich bin mit dem Serum super zufrieden, hilft bei unreiner und groß poriger Haut sehr. Dazu der super Preis für 100 ml. Gerne wieder!

Sérum très efficace pour apaiser la peau, les rougeurs et les boutons, qui hydrate avec une texture légère et en plus de ça il floute les pores pour un aspect de la peau plus net. J'en suis satisfait.

avis.titre: Siero leggero e riequilibrante, ideale per pelli miste ma non miracoloso
avis.texte: Ampoule SKIN1004 alla Centella molto leggera e piacevole da usare. La texture è fluida e si assorbe rapidamente senza lasciare la pelle appiccicosa, caratteristica molto apprezzata soprattutto per pelli miste o grasse. Aiuta a mantenere la pelle più equilibrata e fresca durante la giornata. Con l’uso costante si nota un miglioramento generale dell’aspetto della pelle, con pori leggermente meno visibili e meno lucidità. Non è però un prodotto con effetti immediati o particolarmente intensivi, ma più adatto a mantenimento e routine quotidiana. Pro: - Texture leggera e assorbimento rapido - Non appiccicoso - Adatto a pelli miste/grasse - Buona sensazione di freschezza Contro: - Effetti graduali - Non molto incisivo su problemi più evidenti Conclusione: buon siero per uso quotidiano, equilibrante e facile da integrare nella skincare, ma senza risultati immediati.
